ev: Built and ran the production detection platform end to end — owned it in prod, not just designed it.
Walked a real detection he shipped — the logic, the false-positive tuning, the rollout.
Named the risks — prompt injection, data leakage — but could not point to a control he had tested in production.
Clear on the full pipeline — training data, eval, deployment — from having built it.
Automates his own tooling well; a couple of the scripts were still manual glue.
Understands the principle, but had not implemented fine-grained access controls himself.
Deploys and operates on cloud confidently; lighter on cost and multi-region trade-offs.
Has handled incidents, but spoke more as a contributor than as the owner on call.
Answers matched the CV; flagged the two gaps before I asked.
